title: Mobile Suit Gundam
overview:
Climb into the cockpit of the RX-78-2 Gundam as Amuro Ray and defend the White Base against the forces of Zeon and Char Aznable, the Red Comet. The story follows the events of the first three Mobile Suit Gundam films, told through cutscenes between the action.

This side-scrolling action game mixes run-and-gun shooting with close-range sword combat. Fight through stages based on locations from the films and take down enemy mobile suits with the Gundam's beam saber, beam rifle and hyper bazooka.

- 1 player
- Memory backup support
